note: Hand-picked free full-length courses. Nothing here is written by the app: `npm run courses` fetches each video's real title, channel, length and chapter list from YouTube and writes studio/courses/<id>.json. Only `name`, `track` and `blurb` are ours, and they describe what the video is, never what it says.

courses.name: Networking & the OSI model
courses.blurb: Four hours down the seven layers, with the protocols and the hardware that sit on each one.

courses.name: System design
courses.blurb: One server, then load balancers, caches, CDNs and the API choices that come with them.

courses.name: Databases with SQL
courses.blurb: Relational modelling from tables and keys through joins, functions and triggers.

courses.name: Operating systems
courses.blurb: Processes, threads, scheduling and memory — what the machine is doing under your program.

courses.name: Linux
courses.blurb: The shell, the file system and the permissions model, from a standing start.

courses.name: Design patterns
courses.blurb: The classic patterns in plain English — what each one is for, in language-neutral terms.

courses.name: Design patterns & SOLID in C#
courses.blurb: The long version: SOLID and the pattern catalogue worked through in C#, twelve hours of it.

courses.name: C
courses.blurb: Pointers, memory and the standard library — the language the rest of the stack is written in.

courses.name: C++
courses.blurb: Beginner to advanced C++, from syntax through classes, templates and the standard library.

courses.name: Assembly (ARM)
courses.blurb: Registers, instructions and memory addressing on ARM — what your compiler actually emits.

courses.name: Git
courses.blurb: Commits, branches, merges and remotes, worked through rather than memorised as commands.

courses.name: Docker
courses.blurb: Images, containers, volumes and compose, up to deploying a containerised app.

courses.name: Interview patterns
courses.blurb: The handful of shapes most interview problems reduce to, one after another.

courses.name: Data structures
courses.blurb: Arrays through heaps, tries and union-find, with the implementation shown each time.

courses.name: NeetCode 150 walkthrough
courses.blurb: The course this workspace was generated from: every problem in the list, solved on video.

courses.name: Concurrency & multithreading
courses.blurb: Threads, locks, atomics and the visibility problem - the half of a system that only breaks under load.

courses.name: Debugging with GDB
courses.blurb: Breakpoints, watchpoints and reading a core dump, so a crash becomes a question you can ask rather than a guess.

courses.name: Binary exploitation
courses.blurb: Buffer overflows from the attacker's side, which is the only way the defences stop being abstract.
